shortBio: Tel K. Ganesan is an Executive Chairman, enterprise builder, investor, and producer based in Metro Detroit. Kyyba is the cornerstone of his enterprise-building journey. He hosts Mind Trap, leads Kyyba Films, and focuses on enterprise value, leadership development, selective investment, and legacy.
fullBio: Tel K. Ganesan is an Executive Chairman, enterprise builder, investor, and producer. Based in Metro Detroit, he has built and supported businesses, creative projects, and community initiatives across cultures and industries. Kyyba remains the cornerstone of his enterprise-building journey.

Today, Tel focuses his time where founder judgment matters most: enterprise value, consequential relationships, leadership development, selective investment, narrative, and legacy. His work is grounded in a simple belief: possibility becomes durable only when people, systems, and purpose grow together.
principles: Build the system, not dependence on the founder.
Persist in the purpose; stay flexible about the vehicle.
Protect the capacity behind the contribution.
